name: html-injected-figure-carries-container-height
description: A bare source whose authored CSS drives a percentage height (including behind a media query) must carry height:100% on the injected wp-block-image figure. Without the carry the authored img{height:100%} resolves against the auto-height figure instead of the source container and the image collapses to a short intrinsic-ratio strip.

source_reference.notes: Derived from a restaurant hero where is a direct child of .hero-media{height:100%} with a desktop media rule .hero-media img{height:100%;min-height:100%}. The injected figure (height:auto) broke the percentage chain and left empty space below the hearth image.

legacy_comparison.reason: Covers current PHP transformer image serialization behavior; no downstream legacy comparison.
